ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an SDS-PAGE gel electrophoresis apparatus, with the sample wells and “Samples” marked near the top of the gel, and A marked at the upper electrode/top region; purple bands in the gel are distributed from top to bottom, with larger fragments labeled on the left being higher up and smaller fragments being lower down; B is marked at the electrode region at the bottom/right lower end of the apparatus. Reasoning: In SDS-PAGE, after proteins are coated by SDS, they are overall negatively charged, so they move toward the positive electrode, that is, the anode. In the figure, the migration direction of the bands is from the top sample wells downward, so the electrode located below is the anode, corresponding to the letter B.

raw_record.question_text: The apparatus in the figure is used for SDS-PAGE (polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis). Which letter indicates the anode?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: samples are loaded in wells at the top, and the fragment bands appear progressively lower in the gel, with the lower end of the apparatus labeled B. Use the SDS-PAGE rule that SDS-coated proteins are negatively charged and move toward the positive electrode/anode. Since the migration direction is downward from the wells, the lower electrode indicated by B is the anode.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是SDS-PAGE凝胶电泳装置，样品孔和“Samples”标在凝胶顶部附近，A标在上方电极/顶部区域；凝胶中紫色条带从上到下分布，左侧标注较大的片段在较上方、较小的片段在较下方；B标在装置下方/右下端的电极区域。推理：SDS-PAGE中，蛋白质被SDS包被后整体带负电，因此会向正极即阳极移动。图中条带迁移方向是从顶部样品孔向下方移动，所以位于下方的电极是阳极，对应字母B。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In SDS-PAGE, SDS coats proteins with negative charge, so they migrate through the gel toward the positive electrode, the anode. The direction of migration therefore points from the wells toward the anode.

method.method_draft: Inspect the diagram and locate the two letter labels: A is adjacent to the top wells, and B is at the bottom/right buffer chamber. Apply the standard SDS-PAGE apparatus convention: the well end is the cathode side, while the lower reservoir is the positive anode side. Therefore, the anode is labeled B.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个垂直 SDS-PAGE 电泳装置，凝胶板上方有样品孔和样品，字母 A 的箭头指向上方靠近样品孔的位置；字母 B 的箭头指向装置下方/右侧的缓冲液槽区域。图中还标出了 buffer、gel、plastic frame，以及较大片段在上方、较小片段在下方的迁移方向。

推理：在 SDS-PAGE 中，蛋白质被 SDS 赋予总体负电荷，因此从加样孔所在的上端向下方正极迁移。上端靠近加样孔的一侧是阴极，底部缓冲液槽是阳极。因此图中表示阳极的是 B。
